description: Figure 2 is a circular chart divided into nine distinct colored segments, each labeled with a capability name and a numerical value. The segments are arranged around a central white circle and are visually ordered in a clockwise direction, starting from the top with “Prioritization” (100) in a light blue segment, followed by “Triggering” (100) in a darker blue, then “Recursive Reasoning” (110) in a medium blue, “Dynamic Environment” (100) in a teal, “Memorization” (100) in a light green, “Dynamic Instruction” (100) in a slightly darker green, “Multitasking” (160) in a dark green, “Privacy Protection” (111) in a red, and finally “Personalization” (100) in an orange-red segment. Each segment’s numerical value is printed in black text near its outer edge, and the capability name is printed in black text along the outer ring of the chart. There is no legend or percentage labels inside the slices, and no segments are visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or bolded). The chart visually represents the nine capabilities of the MULTI TURN INSTRUCT benchmark, with the numerical values indicating the number of samples for each capability, as stated in the caption.
